summary: Writes a race-results text file to disk: allocates a results path, ensures every intermediate directory exists, derives the output filename (timestamped when multiplayer, fixed 'RaceResults.txt' for single-player session type 7), then, after opening the file, writes a metadata header, an optional multiplayer local-settings/drive-aids block, and one row per finishing driver (qualifying time, race place/laps, per-lap times, best lap, finish status, total fines). The path buffer is freed on exit.

local_names.v13: driver record pointer from vehicle pointer array

operations.description: Allocate a 256-byte path buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, clear its first byte, and record capacity 256.

Seed the results path: copy the base directory string into the buffer with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, choosing dword_5EC438 when non-null else byte_5EA438, then append the 'results' directory token with sub_5665B0(aResults).

Walk the path string (bounded at 0x400 chars); at each '\' separator (0x5C) copy the substring prefix into PathName via sub_587DD0, null-terminate it, and create that intermediate directory with CreateDirectoryAWrapper.
Create the final results directory with CreateDirectoryAWrapper on the whole path.
Read the current local time: sub_5896EE(v24) fills a raw time struct, then sub_589E6C(v24) converts it to a six-element array (sec/min/hour/day/month/year).
Format the header timestamp '%d/%0.2d/%0.2d %0.2d:%0.2d:%0.2d' with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using year=arr[5]+1900, month=arr[4]+1, day=arr[3], hour=arr[2], min=arr[1], sec=arr[0].
Branch on byte_7D0B28 (multiplayer flag): non-zero selects the timestamped filename path.
Multiplayer path: format the timestamped filename '%d_%0.2d_%0.2d_%0.2d_%0.2d_%0.2d.txt' into v30 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and append it to the path with sub_5665B0.
Non-multiplayer path: when dword_7C56A4 (session type) is not 7, jump to LABEL_46 and skip all file output, going straight to cleanup.
Non-multiplayer, session type 7: append the fixed 'RaceResults.txt' name token with sub_5665B0(aRaceresultsTxt).
Zero-initialize the file-write context v20 with ZeroInitSmallStruct.
Open the results file with sub_566940(path, 0, 1, 1); if it does not return 1 the write block is skipped.
Write the header metadata labels via BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck: aHeader, aGameS, aVersion3f, aTimestringS, &word_5C30B4, aRace, aRacemodeD, aSceneS, aAidbS, aQualifyLapsD, aRaceLapsD.
Compute an integer race-duration value: v19 = (flt_8ACF94 - flt_8ACF90) * 0.016666668, then v21 = (int)v19.
Write the remaining header labels via BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck: aRaceTimeD, aRaceLength3f, aTrackLength4f, &word_5C30B4.
When byte_7D0B28 (multiplayer flag) is non-zero, additionally emit a local-settings / drive-aids block.

Write the local-settings and drive-aids labels via BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck: aLocalSettings, aDriveaidsSteer, aDriveaidsSteer_0, aDriveaidsThrot, aDriveaidsBrake, aDriveaidsAntil, aDriveaidsSpinR, aDriveaidsInvul, aDriveaidsAutop, aDriveaidsOppos, aDriveaidsStabi, aDriveaidsNoAiC, aDriveaidsAllow, aDriveaidsAutoC, aDriveaidsAutoL, aDriveaidsAutoB, aDriveaidsShift, aDriveaidsAutoR, aDriveaidsSpeed, aDriveaidsHalfR, aDriveaidsExtra, aMechfailRateD, aGameoptDamagem, aFuelMultD, aTireMultD, aVehiclesAllowe, aMultiDataRateD, &word_5C30B4, aControls.
Multiplayer block: walk the global entries from dword_7D1B08 up to (but not including) dword_7D1FD8, advancing 7 dwords per step, writing the aDDD_0 token for each entry; finish with &word_5C30B4.

Per-driver output loop: for each grid position i from 1 to dword_5C329C (vehicle count), scan the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 and select the driver whose position field (record + 16480) equals i.
Write the per-driver row labels via BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck: aSlot03d, aDriverS, aVehicleS, aQualplaceD.
Qualifying time (float at record + 16476): when <= 0.0 write aQualtime; otherwise convert with FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder and write aQualtimeD063f.
Write the race-place and race-laps labels via BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck: aRaceplaceD, aRacelapsD.

Multiplayer per-lap block: for each lap index j below the lap-count field (results record + 8), read the lap time with ArithmeticComparison_c2a0; when it is > 0.0, read per-lap data with sub_4BC270, convert via FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder, and write aLapD3fD063f.
Best race time (float at results record + 104): when <= 0.0 write aRacebesttime; otherwise convert with FloatToIntConversionWithRemainder and write aRacebestlapD06.

Switch on the race-status enum (dword at results record + 48, jump table jpt_4D2CB0): cases 0 and 2 write aRacetimeDnf then aReasonD; case 1 converts the race time (float at results record + 132) via FloatToIntTruncateWithRemainder into v21 and writes aRacetimeD02d06; case 3 writes aRacetimeDq; default emits nothing.
Total fines (float at results record + 164): when > 0.0 write aTotalFines1f; then write the row terminator &word_5C30B4.
Close the results file context with ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch(v20).
Clean up the file-write context v20 with SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree.
